title: O Primeiro Dia de Verdade
summary: Kairos begins a non-mechanical development day for its three signed Counter-Strike players, emphasizing trust, honesty, and responsibility before server work.
keyEvents: Atlas, Glacier, and MoteConHuesillo begin the day as signed professional players.
Luk and Trace conduct trust and integration exercises without opening Counter-Strike.
Atlas defines captaincy as accepting blame first and sharing credit with others.
characterDevelopments: Atlas articulates a responsibility-first view of captaincy.

MoteConHuesillo identifies fear of wasting the Kairos opportunity.
